annotations.title: Steel bar grating load and span calculator

description: Finds the lightest welded steel bearing bar (19-W-4 or 15-W-4, smooth or serrated) that carries a clear span and load within a deflection limit.

area_sqft.description: Optional total grating area for an approximate total weight.

deflection.description: Deflection limit in inches, span240 (span / 240), span360 (span / 360) or none (strength only). Ignored for ped.

load.description: ped = pedestrian, 100 lb/sq ft with a 1/4 in deflection limit; uni = uniform load you give in value; con = concentrated load at mid-span you give in value.

pattern.description: 19-W-4 (1-3/16 in bar centres), 15-W-4 (15/16 in) or both.

span_ft.description: Clear span in feet, measured in the direction of the bearing bars, 0.5 to 12. Give only one of span_ft, span_in, span_mm. Default 3 ft.

surface.description: Serrated bars are calculated 1/4 in shallower.

value.description: The load to check when load is uni (lb/sq ft) or con (lb per ft of grating width). Required for uni and con.

name: bar_grating_load_calculator
